Each brick is 2-year training, 393 supervised foldings, hygiene exam, annual fees, laid by a different hand, in a different year. The nadir names the issuer, the pigment names the price, and the kernel names the date: a forger must forge all three. Scale is the farm's enemy, and this check makes scale expensive.
